profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | C# / .NET Core | Distributed Systems & APIs | Real-Time Platforms | AWS Certified
profile.summary:
Senior software engineer with 12+ years building backend systems that people depend on in real time.
For the past decade I've been lead developer and technical owner of a real-time platform used by fire and EMS dispatch centers across the US, Canada, and Australia — now serving around 125 agencies. That means I own the whole thing: the architecture proposals, the APIs, the database schema, the browser interface, the deployment story, and the pager when something breaks at 3am.
A few problems I've enjoyed solving:
• Cutting a client's network traffic by roughly 93% through payload compression and server-side snapshot diffing, sending only deltas to concurrent sessions while holding sub-second update latency.
• Designing an integration bridge that connects around 15 third-party dispatch vendors — a pluggable ingestion layer over database, REST, TCP socket, and webhook sources that normalizes wildly different vendor formats into canonical domain models and routes events downstream at high throughput.
• Acting as one of the core architect on a company-wide re-platform from .NET Framework and ASMX web services to .NET Core with Clean Architecture across four applications, including shared infrastructure packages that let any application deploy on-premise or to the cloud by configuration alone — in-memory versus Redis caching, file-system versus CloudWatch logging.
I care about correctness and maintainability more than cleverness, and I've learned that documentation and knowledge transfer are engineering work: the troubleshooting guides I wrote now let our PMs and QA analysts resolve most deployment issues without engineering involvement.
I use AI-assisted development tooling (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) daily in a production codebase — for generation, review, refactoring, and test authoring — with human oversight where correctness and security matter.
Core stack: C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Web API, microservices, REST API design, event-driven architecture, SignalR, SQL Server, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Redis, AWS, JavaScript, ArcGIS JS API

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Lead developer and technical owner of a real-time coverage-monitoring platform used by ~125 fire and EMS agencies across the US, Canada, and Australia.
• Architect and develop C#/.NET Core microservices and secure RESTful Web APIs powering a data-intensive SaaS platform, with end-to-end ownership from design through deployment and production support.
• Cut per-client network traffic by ~93% by implementing payload compression and server-side snapshot diffing over SignalR, delivering only deltas to concurrent sessions while holding sub-second update latency.
• Designed and own the CAD integration bridge spanning ~15 third-party dispatch vendors: a pluggable ingestion layer over database, REST, TCP live-transport, and webhook sources that normalizes arbitrary vendor formats into canonical domain models and routes events downstream in real time.
• Core architect of a company-wide re-platform from .NET Framework/ASMX to .NET Core with Clean Architecture across four applications; authored shared infrastructure NuGet packages letting any app deploy on-premise or to AWS by configuration alone (in-memory vs Redis caching, file-system vs CloudWatch/X-Ray logging).
• Built the real-time map interface (ArcGIS JS API) for live unit tracking and citywide coverage, the user management and LDAP authentication module, and a map layer upload/download and geocoding module used by another company product.
• Reduced open infrastructure defects by roughly 90% through systematic stabilization; implemented active-active failover and carry production on-call, joining client troubleshooting calls during incidents.
• Architected the next-generation platform (system design and database schema) and mentor a colleague through handover; peer-review code across product teams and trained PMs and QA analysts to resolve most deployment and configuration issues independently.
positions.insights: C#, Event Driven Programming and +15 skills

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Stabilized and extended a defect-heavy early web release, resolving live-client issues first and steadily improving reliability and usability to support client growth.
• Designed and implemented new systems and features integrating with the existing SaaS product, developing to company coding standards and quality processes.
• Triaged, analyzed, and resolved escalated issues from customers and project managers, working across Sales, Engineering, and Product Development to deliver quality releases.
Skills: C# · .NET · SQL · JavaScript · Debugging · Customer Support
